name: CMB Sky
desc: The cosmic microwave background painted as a full-sky Mollweide oval — the faint temperature anisotropies of the infant universe rendered as a slowly boiling false-color mottle, hot and cold spots drifting under a thin graticule of meridians and parallels.

energy.doc: temperature contrast / exposure of the anisotropy

scale.doc: angular size of hot/cold spots (feature scale)

hue.doc: deep-space ground tint outside the oval

style.doc: false-color colormap discipline (contour = schematic iso-temperature bands)

warp.doc: domain-warp amplitude of the slow boil
